## Network requirements

{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} downloads updates from Microsoft servers. If your network has restricted access, ensure the following hostname is allowed:

* `update.code.visualstudio.com` - {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} download and update server

See the [network documentation](/docs/setup/network.md#common-hostnames) for a complete list of hostnames.
